mapper.insert: INSERT INTO look_room_member (id, look_category, user_id, joined_at) VALUES (nextval('look_room_member_seq'), #{lookCategory}, #{userId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (look_category, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM look_room_member WHERE look_category = #{lookCategory} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM look_room_member WHERE look_category = #{lookCategory}
SELECT look_category AS lookCategory, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM look_room_member GROUP BY look_category

SELECT nextval('look_room_message_seq')
INSERT INTO look_room_message (id, look_category, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{lookCategory}, #{userId}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.look_category, m.user_id, m.content, m.created_at, u.display_name AS sender_name, u.avatar_path AS sender_avatar_path FROM look_room_message m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.look_category = #{lookCategory} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
